# GitHub Issue Drafts and Publication Record

Generated drafts: **27**.

The 27 drafts were reviewed and published at <https://github.com/luanthuco11/hw06-api-testing/issues>. Each published Issue embeds its matching representative screenshot from `evidence/`.

The publication workflow was:

1. Open the linked Newman HTML report.
2. Capture a real screenshot showing the case ID, request/response, and failed assertion.
3. Attach the image to the GitHub Issue and replace the screenshot placeholder.
4. Verify severity and avoid duplicating an already published root cause.

The Markdown files remain reproducible source drafts. The public Issue URLs and committed screenshots are the publication evidence.
